voice.unsupported: Your browser cannot record audio. Type your answer.
voice.denied: Microphone permission denied. Enable it in the browser or type.
voice.noSpeech: I did not hear anything. Try again.
voice.failed: I could not process the audio. Try again or type.
voice.noKey: The GEMINI_API_KEY is missing on the server. Type your answer.

onboarding.title: Have you worked with scientific data before?
onboarding.subtitle: This lets us adapt the tool to you. You can change it any time.
onboarding.newDesc: A few short questions, plus step-by-step examples you can watch.
onboarding.expertDesc: Go straight to the tool: region, period, variables and analysis.
onboarding.voiceHint: You can also say: “I'm new” or “I have experience”.
onboarding.notUnderstood: I did not catch that. Pick an option, or say “I'm new” or “I have experience”.
onboarding.spoken: Have you worked with scientific data before? Say I'm new, or I have experience.

guided.introTitle: Let's investigate a place on the planet
guided.introDesc: Answer three short questions, by voice or with a click, and we will find the NASA data that best shows change.
guided.spokenIntro: Let's investigate a place on the planet. Answer three short questions, or watch an example.
guided.q1: What do you want to investigate?
guided.q1Hint: Pick a topic or say it: rain, heat, plants or soil.
guided.q2Hint: Say or type a place. You can also pick one from the list.
guided.q3: Which period do you want to look at?
guided.q3Hint: More years give more evidence. Say five, ten, or historical.
guided.regionNotFound: I did not recognise that place. Try a country, region or landform.
guided.topicNotUnderstood: I did not catch the topic. Pick an option.
guided.periodNotUnderstood: I did not catch the period. Pick an option.
guided.suggestIntro: Ranked by their potential to reveal a trend in this place. Remove any you do not want.
guided.limits: A match between variables describes a relationship; it does not prove which caused which.
guided.spokenQ1: What do you want to investigate? Rain, heat, plants or soil water.
guided.spokenQ2: Where? Say a place, for example the Amazon.
guided.spokenQ3: Which period do you want? Five years, ten, or the full record.
guided.spokenSuggest: These are the variables with the most potential to show change.

demo.label: Example
demo.done: That's it. Now it's your turn.
demo.note: Analysis values in this example are illustrative.

chat.subtitle: Your Moody Trends guide
chat.greeting: Hi! I'm Moody. I can explain any part of Moody Trends: regions, NASA data, or how to read the results. What would you like to know?
chat.error: I could not answer right now. Please try again in a few seconds.
chat.noKey: The GEMINI_API_KEY is missing on the server, so I cannot answer yet.

regionStep.title: Study region
regionStep.description: Type or say the area you want to investigate.
regionStep.hint: With the microphone you can say “Amazon Basin” or “Nicaragua”.
regionStep.notFound: I did not recognise that place. Try another name.

periodStep.title: Period
periodStep.description: Trends need several years to separate the seasonal cycle from real change.

variablesStep.title: Variables
variablesStep.description: Choose what to measure. Each is analysed separately, then compared.

resultsStep.title: Results
resultsStep.description: Linear trend per variable with confidence interval and Holm adjustment, computed on the backend.
resultsStep.illustrative: Illustrative values from the project guide; not yet computed from real data.
resultsStep.sent: Polygon and parameters sent to the backend.
resultsStep.sendFailed: The backend did not respond. Start the server at {url}.
resultsStep.limits: A match between variables does not prove cause. Relevant is not the same as significant.
resultsStep.loading: Computing the four trends on the backend…
resultsStep.offlineHint: Check that the server is running at {url} and try again.
resultsStep.noData: This data is not in the server memory yet.
resultsStep.seriesRejected: The series has too many months without data to be analysed with confidence.
resultsStep.badRequest: The period or region is not valid for the backend. Check the dates (2001-2024).
resultsStep.genericError: The backend returned an error. Please try again.
resultsStep.syntheticNote: Deterministic synthetic values computed by the backend without contacting NASA: they let you test the interface and are not real measurements.
resultsStep.vegetationSoon: Vegetation (NDVI): coming soon. The backend does not include this variable yet.
resultsStep.lagSensitive: The result changes when the adjustment lag changes (lag sensitive).
resultsStep.relationsNote: Exploratory correlations after removing season and trend. They describe coincidences, not causes.
resultsStep.anomaliesNote: Each series in deviations from its typical month (unitless).
resultsStep.familyNote: The four variables are tested together (Holm adjustment), even if you hide one.
resultsStep.checkingMemory: Looking for the analysis in the server memory…
resultsStep.jobTitle: Downloading real NASA data and computing
resultsStep.jobNote: The first time takes a while (10 to 30 minutes per region, depending on the network). After that it stays on the server and the answer is instant.
resultsStep.jobFailed: The analysis with real NASA data could not be completed. No made-up data was used.
resultsStep.jobNotReady: The analysis has not finished yet.
resultsStep.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than the maximum size (5 MB).
resultsStep.qualityNote: Cleaning applied before the calculation. Missing months are never filled with 0 nor interpolated.
resultsStep.labelIncrease: Increase with statistical evidence under this method
resultsStep.labelDecrease: Decrease with statistical evidence under this method
resultsStep.estimatePositive: Positive estimate without sufficient evidence: it does not mean there was no change.
resultsStep.estimateNegative: Negative estimate without sufficient evidence: it does not mean there was no change.
resultsStep.uploadDesc: Upload a monthly regional series (date, P, T, SM, ET or the NASA field names) and it is computed with the same method.
resultsStep.uploadSimulated: This is simulated data (it will be labelled as such)
resultsStep.noCredentialsTitle: The API has no NASA credentials
resultsStep.noCredentials: The API server ({url}) has no EARTHDATA_USERNAME and EARTHDATA_PASSWORD configured, so it cannot download real NASA data and returns synthetic demo data. Configure them on the server to see real results.

backend.offlineShort: No connection to the backend. Check that it is running and try again.

analysis.title: 3D analysis
analysis.hint: Drag to rotate · scroll to zoom · hover to read the value
analysis.carpetDesc: Each row is a year and each column a month. Height and colour show how far it was from normal. On the right, each year's value with its trend line.
analysis.relationsDesc: Each sphere is a variable. Link thickness and flow follow the correlation strength; the arrow shows whether it rises or falls.
analysis.mapDesc: Each bar is a pixel of the region. Height is the change per decade; muted bars have no clear trend.
analysis.mapError: The map for this variable could not be loaded
analysis.noSeries: This variable has no series to show in 3D.

notFound.title: Lost in orbit
notFound.description: We couldn't find this page. It may have moved, or the link may be mistyped.

server.title: Something failed at our station
server.description: An unexpected error occurred while showing this section. You can retry; if it persists, go back home.

offline.title: No internet connection
offline.description: Moody Trends needs internet to query NASA data and Gemini. This screen will close on its own when the connection returns.

backend.title: There's a problem with the server
backend.description: We couldn't load the data right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
